scope: Ten independent native source-art states and components extending forty-six previously selected PNGs.
reviewer: Root coordinating assistant; each selected output directly displayed against source references.
method: Separate source/new PNG visual inspection, byte hashes and alpha measurements. Not an in-game or human-art validation.

Silhouette entière ; pointe haute à seulement 4 px du bord au seuil alpha > 24, cadrage natif serré documenté. Les surfaces précédemment cachées sont reconstruites.

Vue et proportions visuellement proches de la référence compacte ; échelle physique et superposition exacte non certifiées.

limits: Nine requests inherit their reference camera views; S17 requests the project camera. No actual camera angle is measured.
K21 turns the gate object while requesting the source camera; the previously hidden face is reconstructed as an original game adaptation.
K19 and the gate use their own native framing. A common pixel scale, complete layer alignment and exact hardware joints are not certified.
S15 has a 4 px main-silhouette margin at alpha>24. Native low-alpha edge noise remains, with no scripted cleanup or padding.
No physical dimensions, capacity, species fit, collision, navigation, interaction, animation, runtime admission or canonical 1:1 certification is claimed.
Forty-six previous selected PNGs remain byte-identical; rejected first attempts are counted separately.
